第480章 皇上的决定（第1页）
皇甫皓轩知道，如果伟祺帝看到他的奏折一定也会大吃一惊的。
皇位，自然是要传给最合适的人选，不是吗？
皇甫皓轩虽然是太子，可是他的性格并没有皇甫亦轩好，做事也不够果断。
虽然会有一些小智慧，可是做皇上掌管天下靠的并不是智慧，而是多方面综合在一起的优秀体。
他为人霸气，处理事情干净利落，有着聪明的头脑和能够狠得下来的心肠。
所以皇甫亦轩才是皇位继承人的最佳人选。
至于他，他只想随着蓝若晴浪迹天涯去！
真正的原因，是在百姓中生活，才知道百姓的疾苦，才知道人世间的不平事。
而他，愿意做这双眼睛，这对耳朵。
将他所听到的，所看到的事情，传达给皇上。
无论这个皇上是当今的伟祺帝还是未来的皇甫亦轩，相信都会处理的很好的。
这个皇甫皓轩啊，就是这样子的让人心疼，让人喜欢。
伟祺帝再将那奏折拿起来看了一眼，心痛的再次放下。
“唉！”伟祺帝长长的叹了一口气。
“皇上，怎么了？遇到了什么为难的事么？”
自从沐贵妃被打入冷宫以后，皇后就每日伺候着皇上。
自然也是个极好的助手，常常帮皇上分析着局势。

而伟祺帝也已经习惯了身边有这样一个人帮忙。
“你自己看看！”伟祺帝将皇甫皓轩的奏折递给皇后，拿起茶杯喝了一口茶水。
皇后沏的茶果然是与众不同的，总是特别的香浓。
皇后看完奏折，轻轻的放下，脸上并没有什么变化，就好像这事完全在他的预料之中一样。
伟祺帝惊异与皇后的不变化，他不知道皇后为什么可以看起来那么平静。
“臣妾觉得皓轩的做法很好，臣妾支持他。”
“为什么？那可是朕的大好江山，拥有了，就拥有整个天下。可是你却支持他放弃？”
“是的！臣妾支持他！臣妾的想法和皓轩一样，做在皇位之上，能够看到什么？可是游遍天下，却可以看到更多的百姓疾苦。所以臣妾支持他！”
“朕的妃子皇儿，有的拼命的为了皇位而去争夺，而有的却根本就不想要。想想陌轩可悲的人生，再看看你与皓轩的洒脱，朕真的是不知道该说什么！”
“皇上，都是您的儿子，哪个继承皇位其实都是一样的。臣妾觉得亦轩他够霸气，完全有你当年的风范，这皇位的人选，他是最合适的。所以皇上，您就不要再犹豫了。”
“真的要这样吗？”伟祺帝不确定的追问。
“嗯！”皇后用力的点头，代表着她的意见，还有对皇甫皓轩的肯定。
伟祺帝看着皇后那坚定的目光，拿起毛笔，在皇甫皓轩的奏折上写了一个大大的“准”字！

Chapter 480 The Emperor’s Decision (Page 1)
Huangfu Haoxuan knew that Emperor Wei Qi would be shocked if he saw his memorial.
The throne must naturally be passed on to the most suitable candidate, right?
Although Huangfu Haoxuan is the prince, his character is not as good as Huangfu Yixuan, and he is not decisive enough in his actions.
Although there will be some small wisdom, being an emperor and ruling the world is not based on wisdom, but on an excellent body that integrates many aspects.
He is domineering, handles things neatly, has a smart mind and a ruthless heart.
Therefore, Huangfu Yixuan is the best candidate to succeed the throne.
As for him, he just wants to follow Lan Ruoqing and wander around the world!
The real reason is that only by living among the common people can you understand the sufferings of the common people and the injustices in the world.
And he is willing to be these eyes and ears.
Convey what he heard and saw to the emperor.
Whether this emperor is the current Emperor Wei Qi or the future Huangfu Yixuan, I believe he will handle it well.
This Huangfu Haoxuan is so heart-warming and likeable.
Emperor Wei Qi picked up the memorial and took a look at it, then put it down again with heartache.
"Alas!" Emperor Wei Qi let out a long sigh.
"Your Majesty, what's wrong? Did you encounter any difficulty?"
Since Concubine Mu was thrown into the cold palace, the queen has been serving the emperor every day.
Naturally, he was also an excellent assistant, often helping the emperor analyze the situation.
And Emperor Wei Qi was used to having such a person beside him to help.
"See for yourself!" Emperor Wei Qi handed Huangfu Haoxuan's memorial to the queen, picked up the tea cup and took a sip of tea.
The tea brewed by the Queen is indeed unique, always particularly fragrant.
After the queen read the memorial, she put it down gently, with no change on her face, as if this was completely expected.
Emperor Wei Qi was surprised by the lack of change in the queen. He didn't know why the queen could look so calm.
"I think what Haoxuan is doing is good, and I support him."
"Why? That is my great country. If you own it, you will own the whole world. But you support him to give up?"
"Yes! I support him! I have the same idea as Haoxuan. What can I see when I am on the throne? But when I travel around the world, I can see more people suffering. So I support him!"
"Some of my concubines and princes are fighting desperately for the throne, while others don't want it at all. Thinking about Mo Xuan's miserable life, and looking at the free and easy life of you and Haoxuan, I really don't know what to say!"
"Your Majesty, they are all your sons. Whoever inherits the throne is actually the same. I think Yixuan is domineering enough and has exactly the same demeanor as you did back then. He is the most suitable candidate for this throne. So Your Majesty, please don't hesitate any more."
"Is this really necessary?" Emperor Wei Qi asked uncertainly.
"Yes!" The queen nodded vigorously, which represented her opinion and her affirmation of Huangfu Haoxuan.
Emperor Wei Qi looked at the queen's firm gaze, picked up a writing brush, and wrote a big word "accurate" on Huangfu Haoxuan's memorial!
